method_box: Survey of 1,200 US adults who own at least one houseplant, online panel, fielded 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-19.
Margin of error: 2.8 points for all owners, 5.7 points for 18 to 29, 6.3 points for 60 and over, at 95% confidence.
Store data: every order at Example Houseplant Store in each period, counted by product tag; totals only.
What it can't show: the survey asked whether owners lost a plant, not how many; the store data covers one store's customers, not the US market.
All four age groups are shown, including the two in the middle (59.4% and 52.0%).
asset_outline.spokesperson_quote_draft: "Two in three owners under 30 lost a plant last year, and 86% of all the losses came down to water or light. Those are the easiest things to get right." (Spokesperson, Example Houseplant Store, for approval)
